source.note: Synthetic makers in the published shape. Signals are what each source counts, not adoption.

rule.rising: at least one of the maker's products is up 25% or more on its own prior 4 weeks, in Wikipedia views (at least 2,000 views in the prior 4 weeks) or registry downloads (at least 4,000 in the prior 4 weeks)
rule.leader: not rising, and a product in the top quarter of its taxonomy node by Wikipedia views in the last 4 weeks (nodes with at least 4 measured products) whose views grew more than 5% on the prior 4 weeks
rule.incumbent: not rising or leading, and a product in the top quarter of its node by the same measure whose views changed 5% or less (flat or falling)
rule.null: no product meets a rule, or the signals a rule needs are not observed
rule.merge: two Wikidata items are one maker only when one is the other's parent organization (P749) and both carry the same name

suggestion_rule.leader: the most Wikipedia views in the product's taxonomy node in the last 4 weeks
suggestion_rule.trending: the biggest rise in the node on its own prior 4 weeks, at least 25% (views or downloads, with the minimum baselines above)
suggestion_rule.established: the earliest inception year Wikidata records in the node
suggestion_rule.scope: other products filed under the same taxonomy node only, at most one per label, three in all
